evidence.title: GitHub - aaif-goose/goose: an open source, extensible AI agent that goes beyond code suggestions

name: goose
summary: Open-source general-purpose AI agent with a native desktop app, CLI and API for code, automation and research.
description: A general-purpose AI agent that runs on your machine: native desktop app for macOS, Linux and Windows, a CLI and an embeddable API, built in Rust. Works with 15+ model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama, OpenRouter, Azure, Bedrock and more) and 70+ MCP extensions; part of the Agentic AI Foundation at the Linux Foundation.
contains: desktop app for macOS, Linux and Windows
part of the Agentic AI Foundation at the Linux Foundation
